title: Viral BONCAT Protocol
author: Alexis Pasulka
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p9ydr7w
materials: Samples for determining HPG incorporation into viruses are prepared differently than typical viral microscopy (e.g., anodisc filters) to concentrate viruses from a larger volume of seawater and reduce background fluorescence for image analysis. The volume collected for concentrating viruses may vary depending on the environment. For samples collected from a coastal pier site 8 mLs (in duplicate) was pre-filtered through a 0.2 µm filter, and then concentrated using an Amicon Ultra Centrifugal filter (Millipore, 100 K, UFC810096) to approximately 30 µL following the manufacturer’s recommendations (i.e., 4000 rcf for 15 min). Samples were then fixed with glutaraldehyde (0.5% final concentration), flash frozen and stored at -80deg until further analysis.

steps.title: Collect Seawater Samples
steps.instruction: Collect seawater gently to avoid damaging cells, using tools such as Niskin bottles with polycarbonate tubing.

steps.title: Prepare Incubation Bottles
steps.instruction: Fill bottles with equal volumes of seawater, including replicate treatment bottles and control bottles (e.g., no HPG addition).

substeps.instruction: Select appropriate bottles: glass Erlenmeyer flasks with cheesecloth cotton stoppers, glass incubation bottles with screw tops, or clear polycarbonate bottles with screw tops.
If performing a time course, create replicate bottles for each time point to avoid removing too much volume from incubation bottles during sampling.

steps.title: Add HPG to Bottles
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of HPG to the incubation bottles to reach a final concentration of 100 µM.

substeps.instruction: Prepare HPG stock at 100 mM.
Example: Add 250 µL of 100 mM HPG to a 250 mL bottle.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate bottles under light and temperature conditions appropriate for the ecosystem from which the samples were collected.

steps.title: Sample for Viral Mortality
steps.instruction: Sample the bottles at time points based on the expected rate of viral mortality.

substeps.instruction: For fast mortality: sample at 6, 12, and up to 24 hours.
For slower mortality: sample at 24 and 48 hours.

steps.title: Prepare Slides for Click Reaction
steps.instruction: Spot samples onto Teflon printed glass slides (Electron Microscopy Sciences, PTFE Printed Slides) and air-dry.

substeps.instruction: Spot 2–5 µl of sample per well.
Do NOT use poly-l-lysine coated slides.
Gently rinse with 0.02 µm filtered water by pipetting in the direction off the slide.
Air-dry the sample again.

steps.title: Dehydrate Samples
steps.instruction: Perform an ethanol dehydration series using fresh ethanol solutions by placing slides into 50 mL falcon tubes.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in 50:50 v/v EtOH:H2O.
Incubate in 80:20 v/v EtOH:H2O.
Incubate in 96:4 v/v EtOH:H2O.

steps.title: Prepare Click Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the click solution immediately prior to the reaction.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Buffer solution: Mix 12.5 µL of 100 mM sodium ascorbate (in 1X PBS), 12.5 µL of 100 mM aminoguanidine hydrochloride (in 1X PBS), and 220 µL 1X PBS.
Prepare Dye pre-mix: Mix 1.25 µl 20 mM CuSO4, 2.50 µl 50 mM THPTA, and 0.5 µl 1 mM azide dye (TAMRA-azide fluorophore recommended).
Incubate dye pre-mix in the dark for 3 minutes.
Add dye-premix to buffer solution and invert the tube (do not vortex).

steps.title: Perform Click Reaction
steps.instruction: Apply the click solution to the samples and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Place 20 µL of click solution over each well.
Transfer slide to a humid chamber (50-ml falcon tube with water on tissue paper in the bottom).
Incubate in the dark at room temperature (RT) for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash and Dry Samples
steps.instruction: Wash the samples to remove excess dye and salts, then dry.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 1X PBS.
Wash with 0.02 µm filtered water.
Wash with 50:50 v/v EtOH:H2O.
Let the sample dry in the dark.

steps.title: Counterstain Samples
steps.instruction: Counterstain the samples with SYBR Gold.

substeps.instruction: Incubate with SYBR Gold at 0.25% final concentration for 15 minutes.
Wash with water.
Air dry in the dark.

steps.title: Image and Quantify
steps.instruction: Capture digital images using two specific filter sets and quantify HPG incorporation.

substeps.instruction: Use FITC filter set (excitation 480/40 nm; emission 535/50 nm) for SYBR Gold DNA signal.
Use Cy3 filter set (excitation 545/30 nm; emission 620/60 nm) for TAMRA fluorophore click signal.
Measure fluorescence signal of TAMRA relative to SYBR Gold within individual viral particles using a custom Matlab analysis pipeline.
